title: Momoi Airi — Airi's Beauty Salon〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: The Lumina Forum - Ballroom

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hello!
Today's stream is being brought to you from the Lumina Forum!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Have you all been watching the grand prix stream?

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Yes!>
<Of course I've been watching!>
<I've got both streams open in different windows!>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. It looks like many of you have been watching.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Alright, that probably means you guys already know all about the training camp. But since we're here, right...?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, we want to show you guys all the great things this place has to offer.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We're calling this...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
The Special Lumina Grand Prix Stream!
Explore! Discover! MORE MORE TOUR - Training Camp Edition!

rows.Speaker: Haruka, Shizuku & Minori
rows.Line: Yay!!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<You're gonna show us around?>
<I wanna see what kinds of cool stuff this place has!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
But...
A plain old tour would be boring, right?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
So!
We're gonna have a competition to see who gives the best presentation about the training camp!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'll be your MC! And these three will be our competitors!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We promise to give the best presentations we can!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The same place can give off different impressions depending on who presents it and in what way.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: After the tour, please let us know in the comments who you thought did the best.

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Roger!>
<I'm expecting to be blown away!>
<Good luck, everyone!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, it's time for the MORE MORE TOUR to get started! Let's~

rows.Speaker: Minori, Haruka, Airi & Shizuku
rows.Line: Go!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We'll start by showing you all one of the meeting rooms.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
The best part has to be how expansive this space is.
The four of us might have a hard time making use of all of it.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It even has this big monitor, so we might be able to stream one of our brainstorming sessions here for everyone.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, not only are you giving us a solid presentation, but you're also giving us a good idea.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We could show documents and stuff on this monitor while asking our fans what they think about our ideas.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Next, we'd like to show you all the cafeteria. They serve us such delicious food every day here.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I recommend the meat and potato stew...
Not only is it incredibly flavorful, the potatoes just fall apart in your mouth.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, but the Japanese mixed rice was also very good... It looked so appetizing because of all the different ingredients in it.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, all of their dishes have been good.
But the flavor isn't the only reason why this cafeteria's so great, remember?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: They've hired a certified nutritionist to make sure every dish is healthy and will help us stay fit.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We can even ask to have custom dishes made for us.

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Wow, that's pretty cool!>
<Nice report, Airi. You really are a seasoned veteran.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Ta-daa! Welcome, everyone, to MORE MORE JUMP!'s room!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We decided to get it really organized to make sure we can use it as our second base of operations!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
My favorite thing is...
Ta-da! The picture I've placed here!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I know I'll miss him while I'm here, so I decided to frame my favorite photo of Samo!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Samo's so cute!>
<Too close! Too close lol.>
<What's the rest of the room like?>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, I know Samo means a lot, but isn't there something else you should be showing them?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, right!
The penguin plushie over here is—

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: No, that's not what I meant!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You said that we worked hard to organize this room, so why aren't you talking more about that?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You were supposed to say how our workspace is over here and the relaxation area is set up over there, see how everyone responds and answer questions as you go along.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You gotta get them interested and excited about what this place is like.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, right...!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Minori...>
<Airi's tough tutelage lol.>
<Even during this training camp, she can come up with good quips on the spot lol.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, that concludes our report.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What did you guys think? We got around to basically everything.

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<It was great to get to see so much!>
<Good reporting!>
<I didn't think we'd get to see your room!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Thanks!
That means our MORE MORE TOUR was a big success.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Anyway, let's start polling.
Write in the comments who you thought did the best.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, they're coming in already...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you for responding so quickly.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Let's see... Just at a glance, I'm seeing Haruka's name the most.

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Wait, Airi totally did the best.>
<Yeah! Everyone's writing your name, Airi, lol!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<You ended up giving the best explanations lol.>
<Your little skit with Minori was so funny.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, Airi, I think you received the most votes.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: To be fair, you did a good job of filling in all the gaps in our reports.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: U-Uhh... Then, the winner is...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Airi Momoi!
Wait, why's the MC the winner?!

rows.Speaker: Minori, Shizuku & Haruka
rows.Line:
Haha!
Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Honestly, I'm not sure how to feel about this...
But I guess it's all good since you guys ended up enjoying everything.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Anyway, that's all for today!
We've come up with a lot of other ideas, so stay tuned!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Looking forward to seeing more training camp streams!>
<You're gonna win the grand prix! I'm rooting for you girls!>
<Go MMJ!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Thanks!
And we promise to do our best to keep you guys entertained!
